items.title: "They would feel a kind of sadness, right?": Slay the Spire 2 dev on using slightly rubbish placeholder art over AI
items.excerpt: Mega Crit's Casey Yano explains why the Slay the Spire 2 team deliberately uses scrappy hand-made placeholder art instead of generative AI during production. "You don't see the path that somebody took to get better and develop their own style."

items.title: "Built for that world doesn't mean built to require it": Unity reveal their next game engine while walking a careful line around generative AI
items.excerpt: Unity have announced Unity 7, the latest incarnation of their game creation platform, positioning AI-native tooling as optional rather than mandatory for developers.

items.title: Take cover, because it looks like more than half of Steam games will have an AI-disclosure by 2027-2028
items.excerpt: A full census of 53,597 Steam releases finds 30.8% of 2026 games carry an AI disclosure, with the curve pointing at a majority by 2027-2028. Most of that growth comes from games that barely earn anything.

items.title: Mario Kart Wii is being "rebuilt for PC," but the project's AI vibe coding instantly soured many Nintendo fans on the project
items.excerpt: "The first static recompilation of a Wii game" was largely produced with AI coding agents, and the disclosure immediately split the modding community.

items.title: "Steam's required AI disclosure is the right move": Devs say gen AI should be called out in games and support Valve's store mandate
items.excerpt: Developers push back on Tim Sweeney's criticism of Valve's AI labels, arguing disclosure is a baseline creative-credit issue and asking other storefronts to follow.

items.title: According to a poll, Generative AI is being used at a whopping 100% Japanese online game developers, as copyright infringement concerns climb
items.excerpt: The JOGA Online Game Market Research Report 2026 finds universal generative AI adoption among surveyed Japanese online game developers, alongside rising player concern about copyright.

items.title: Reddit is forcing Google AI into hallucinating The Duskbloods characters before FromSoftware's Switch 2 exclusive is even out
items.excerpt: Fan-invented lore posted on Reddit is being treated as fact by Google's AI search, showing how generative summarisation now shapes a game's public identity before launch.

items.title: Even sexy Skyrim mods aren't safe from AI slop anymore
items.excerpt: Bethesda's RPG is seeing a surge of AI-generated mod content on Nexus, some downloaded millions of times, forcing modding communities to rethink curation and labelling.

items.title: Fortnite creators won't be able to escape AI come the end of July
items.excerpt: From July 30, UEFN creators will be able to place AI-powered characters on their Fortnite islands, pushing conversational NPCs into mainstream UGC creation.

items.title: New Viral Friendslop Game Criticized For Epstein Jokes And Generative AI
items.excerpt: Dear Passengers blew up overnight on Steam, but its use of generative AI assets became the flashpoint for a rapid player backlash.

items.title: Persona Artist Promises No AI In Next Game Following Backlash
items.excerpt: Persona and Metaphor artist Kazuma Kaneko says his next game will contain no AI-driven mechanics after fan criticism of an earlier AI-assisted project.

items.title: 'GTA 6' is the "last great game" before AI takes over, says analyst
items.excerpt: An analyst argues GTA 6 marks the end of the hand-crafted blockbuster era, with AI-produced content set to reshape how big games are made and priced.

items.title: Text to speech history: save, replay, and reload every AI voice take (Inworld Text-to-Speech)
items.excerpt: Inworld's TTS Playground now keeps a full history of every generated voice take, with voice, model and settings preserved — a version-control layer for AI game dialogue.

items.title: Keynote | Unite Seoul 2026
items.excerpt: Unity's Unite Seoul keynote gives first looks at major engine updates and the company's AI roadmap for the Unity 7 era.

items.title: MetaHumans in Blender: Using OpenRigLogic to Customize DNA's Behavior | Inside Unreal
items.excerpt: Following Epic's MetaHuman Devkit announcement at Unreal Fest, Poly Hammer shows OpenRigLogic running inside Blender to customise MetaHuman DNA behaviour outside Unreal.

items.title: Minecraft Was Missing One Brilliant Idea
items.excerpt: A walkthrough of new terrain-diffusion research that generates coherent, editable game worlds — a diffusion-model take on procedural level and world generation.
